oneLine: Open-source Next.js 14 e-commerce platform for selling skateboarding products, supporting multi-store sellers, Stripe payments, Clerk auth, and an MDX blog.

stack.text: Framework: Next.js 14.2.5 (App Router) with TypeScript, using route groups for auth, checkout, dashboard, and public lobby.
ORM: Drizzle ORM with PostgreSQL dialect via the `postgres` npm driver (not `pg` — pg is a listed dependency but Drizzle does not use it).
Auth: Clerk (@clerk/nextjs ^5.2.3) — handles sign-in, sign-up, OAuth, and session; root layout wraps the app in ClerkProvider.
Payments: Stripe (stripe ^16.2.0 + @stripe/react-stripe-js) for checkout and seller subscriptions; webhook handler at api/webhooks/stripe.
File uploads: UploadThing (uploadthing ^6.13.2); CDN remote-pattern configured for utfs.io in next.config.js.
Email: Resend (resend ^3.4.0) with React Email components for transactional emails including newsletter.
Content: Contentlayer (^0.3.4) processes MDX from src/content/ for the blog; integrated via withContentlayer wrapper in next.config.js.
UI: shadcn/ui components built on Radix UI primitives + Tailwind CSS; cn() utility for conditional class merging.
Environment validation: @t3-oss/env-nextjs validates all env vars at startup via src/env.js (must import with .js extension).

entryPoints.text: Root HTML shell and global providers (ClerkProvider, ThemeProvider, Toaster, Analytics) are set up in src/app/layout.tsx.
Public storefront (home page) at src/app/(lobby)/page.tsx — fetches featured products, categories, stores with Suspense boundaries.
Clerk middleware protects only /dashboard(.*); all other routes are public. Signed-out users are redirected to /signin.
Stripe webhook entry point at src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts handles payment and subscription events.

keyFacts.text: README states 'Database on PlanetScale' but source code uses PostgreSQL (postgres driver, Drizzle postgresql dialect). PlanetScale claim is outdated.
README marks 'Checkout with Stripe Checkout' as not yet implemented (unchecked box), though a checkout route group and Stripe payment form exist in source.
next.config.js sets eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds and typescript.ignoreBuildErrors to true — CI validation must be run separately via pnpm check.
The project has no automated tests — no test runner (Jest, Vitest, Playwright) is configured and no test script exists in package.json.

DB schema defines 13 tables: addresses, carts, categories, customers, notifications, orders, payments, products, stocks, stores, subcategories, tags, variants — all re-exported from src/db/schema/index.ts.
